verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State publishes fixed turnaround commitments for some transaction types: 24-Hour Expedite and Same-Day online, a 4-hour drop-off service, 24-hour preclearance, and certificates of status "within minutes" online. These are static guarantees for paid or specific services, not current processing times for standard filings. missing for 10: published current/live processing times for standard (non-expedited) filings, per-transaction-type backlog figures, evidence that times are kept up to date, independent corroboration.
